:::{#def-folds}
#### Folds

A division of a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$,
indexed by $\obsidx$, into $\nfolds$ **folds**
is a partition of $\obsidx$ into $\nfolds$ nonempty, disjoint subsets
$\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{\nfolds}$:

$$
\fold{1} \cup \cdots \cup \fold{\nfolds} = \obsidx.
$$ {#eq-folds}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@james2021islr2e [sec. 5.1.3] and @hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1],
who split the data into $\nfolds$ roughly equal-sized parts.
:::

:::
